name: laravel

platform.name: Unknown
platform.why: a self-hosted app: nginx.conf.example and Caddyfile.example are samples for one server, and the release workflow builds an archive; nothing names a host

processes.note: root public/, PHP through fastcgi 127.0.0.1:9000; Caddyfile.example serves the same with FrankenPHP php_server; the Vue/TypeScript client is built by Vite into public/
daily koel:scan, koel:prune, koel:podcasts:sync, temp and duplicate clean-ups, model:prune; started by a system crontab line `php artisan schedule:run` every minute (koel:scheduler:install writes it)

data.note: DB_CONNECTION=mysql, also the default in config/database.php; PostgreSQL and SQLite are supported and tested in CI
SCOUT_DRIVER defaults to tntsearch: MultiIndexSqliteEngine keeps the search indexes as SQLite files in storage/search-indexes

STORAGE_DRIVER=local with MEDIA_PATH: the music library itself lives on the server's disk; images in storage/images, transcodes and temp files under ARTIFACTS_PATH; S3, Dropbox, SFTP and WebDAV drivers exist

breaks.note: with the default local storage, uploaded songs are moved into MEDIA_PATH and the library is scanned from it; File::move, no regex line
album art, artist images and avatars written into storage/images by File::put
the upload is moved to ARTIFACTS_PATH/tmp and its path is handed to HandleSongUploadJob; with an async queue another instance cannot see the file
TNTSearch's SQLite index files are the default search store; each instance would hold its own index on its own disk

breaks.why: a scan log is written into storage/logs with File::put and pruned later; the file is lost with the instance; hidden by the cap until the corpus test listed every place

notBreaks.why: file_put_contents copies a remote song into ARTIFACTS_PATH/tmp for one operation and the caller deletes it; a scratch copy, not stored data
browser code of the Vue client, built by Vite into public/
browser code, a timer in the page
a macro for tests (TestResponse::macro) registered only when tests run; it writes a response into storage/logs

notes: Read nginx.conf.example, Caddyfile.example, .env.example, config/database.php, config/queue.php, config/scout.php, config/cache.php, routes/console.php, app/Jobs, the song storages, the upload controller and the PHP and Node rule hits. Queues: thirteen jobs implement ShouldQueue, but .env.example sets QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync, so they run inside the request and no worker is declared anywhere; config/queue.php falls back to database when the variable is missing, which would need a `php artisan queue:work` process. The scheduler is a cron process driven by a system crontab, not a timer in the process. CACHE_DRIVER=file and SESSION_DRIVER=file also keep state on each instance's disk (the API uses tokens, so sessions matter little), and PHP streaming of audio means long requests; no rule covers these. Only file_put_contents and move_uploaded_file have a PHP regex, so the real disk writes here (File:: facade) have no rule hit.

known.FALSE break: local-disk-write app/Provid: a macro that only exists for tests (TestResponse::macro, registered when tests run) writes a response into storage/logs; the rule cannot see the condition around the registration
known.MISSED break: sqlite-database config/sco: the storage or database is chosen in a settings module or a config key that no rule reads (SCOUT_DRIVER defaults to tntsearch, which keeps SQLite index files)
known.process missing: 1 x cron: the Laravel scheduler is declared in routes/console.php (Schedule::job(...)->daily()) and run by `schedule:run` from a cron entry nobody commits; no reader turns those lines into a cron process
known.data missing: db mysql: MySQL is named only in .env.example and config/database.php's default, and the audit never opens a .env file
known.data missing: sqlite: the storage or database is chosen in a settings module or a config key that no rule reads
known.data extra: cache redis: composer.json requires predis/predis, and Laravel's stock config reads REDIS_* names; the app uses Redis only when the cache or queue driver is set to it, which the default is not
